Mara - Growth Marketing: Quick kickoff for a small launch: "RefApp Playground" 1 an OSS reference + 2 tutorial videos. Need blog post, short benchmark bullets, gated webinar, and lead routing. Who can take what?
Jun - DevRel: I can do tutorials + demo clip. Will run a compact perf matrix (local vs hosted).
Aisha - Content: I'll draft the blog and 5 social variants. Keep tone practical and engineer-first. Two hooks: "try locally" and "optimize latency & cost."
Noelle - Design: I'll prepare hero, one annotated benchmark image, and a 7s demo GIF. Need copy by Wed noon.
Ravi - GrowthOps: Webinar proposed Thu Oct 7, 11am PT. Landing with form -> HubSpot, tag refapp_playground. Rule: company_size>100 -> AE queue.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Jun please give 2-line benchmark bullets: median + p95 and a per-1k-token cost delta. Keep numbers rounded and add "results may vary" note.
Jun - DevRel: Draft bullets: local median ~95ms, p95 ~350ms; hosted median ~125ms, p95 ~420ms. Quantized config ~3x cheaper per-token. I'll finalize harness links.
release-bot: Artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/refapp-playground/v0.9/refapp-playground.tar.gz
Aisha - Content: Outline: TL;DR, 3-step quickstart, benchmark callouts, tutorial links, CTA to webinar and repo. I'll share a draft Tue.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Owners: Jun (tutorials+bench), Aisha (blog+social), Noelle (assets), Ravi (webinar+routing). Target publish + webinar same day Oct 7 AM. I'll post checklist and folder path tomorrow. :rocket:
